root_cause: The coverage-complete critic 19 code review (same Opus High worker) passed treatment A and the measured board but returned revise on treatment B with two blocking motion defects. NB1: the B push stretches the right forearm 12 percent at release and 24 percent at the end of the glide while the hand floats off the card. NB2: three fingers snap between poses in a single frame at 0.43 s, 1.80 s and 14.77 s. Independently classified as non-deferrable modern motion floor failures. The independent recurrence pivot review (critic 20) judged an arm solve and finger blend alone to be a defect correction inside the same push mechanism, not a pivot, and recommended changing the performed action.
repair: Change treatment B's performed send, per the pivot reviewer's option two: the right index keeps continuous fingertip contact with the card's edge and drives it to the tool-mouth lip until the lip occludes the card, with no release, glide or airborne return, and the hand then settles back on the keys through a continuous eased return. Apply the same continuous-contact push to B's s3 question push. Implement it with a constant-length two-bone arm solve from the fixed shoulder (rest forearm and upper-arm lengths) and a finger lift blended into the reach with an eased lerp, all gated to treatment b so treatment a pictures stay unchanged. Edit only ClinicAnswerFilm.tsx. Boards, timing, narration, art files, voice, mix and captions are unchanged.
mechanism_change: B's send changes from a release-and-glide push that leaves the hand floating off the card to a continuous-contact push that carries the card into the tool-mouth lip with the hand attached, solved with constant limb lengths and continuous finger blends.
expected_visible_result: In B the fingertip stays on the card from first touch until the tool-mouth lip occludes it, there is no airborne hand after the card is gone, forearm length is constant, fingers move continuously at 30 fps, and A and the measured selected board render identical pictures.

modern_code_evidence.guide_text:
# Direct the film before describing its look

Owner instruction, October 7th, 2026. Active for newly planned editions from October 8th,
or an explicit `film_direction` opt-in. The original source, rights, minimum action,
native PNG/CRF16, audio, caption, independent panel and autonomous shipment gates remain.

## What the previous upgrade failed to change

October 7th's shipped film passed its mechanical gates and scored 7.596. The owner rejected
its engagement and pace. It repeated an equipment tableau through six scenes, with a 9.5-second
closing scene. Palette, camera poses and declared events did not create a visual argument.
The bounded release contract could also defer pacing, motion, surface finish and ending artistry.
Neither a score nor a completed worksheet overrules that observed failure.

This upgrade therefore changes the executable route and review eligibility. It does not promise
an aesthetic result from a new renderer name. Current production uses `directed-film-v2` and a
registered, story-specific episode. Missing plans, unknown views and legacy routes fail. Older
episodes remain reproducible as historical evidence. A current film cannot defer the four
categories above, even at a creative ceiling. Capacity recovery funds mandatory repair on the
current route; it never restores the retired route or edits a rejected finding.

## Lessons verified in AlaskaAIWeekly

Study pinned source and complete published films, rather than an isolated hero still. The current
reference revision is `e53f3f92e6cbe123e8802239d8172622d4f3a630`.

- [Directors room](https://github.com/Talonsturgill/alaska-ai-weekly/blob/e53f3f92e6cbe123e8802239d8172622d4f3a630/prompts/dispatch_routine.md)
  commits an earned angle, cold open, escalation, performed turn and visual button. Translate its
  contrasting dramatic, comic, explanatory and curious lenses into the existing two complete
  Texas treatments. Do not add daily roles, extra pitches or another paid panel.
- [October 7th episode](https://github.com/Talonsturgill/alaska-ai-weekly/blob/e53f3f92e6cbe123e8802239d8172622d4f3a630/video-engine/src/Ep1007.tsx)
  uses a recurring physical object, distinct shot sizes, local reactions, carefully finished
  silhouettes and named visual reveals. A figure's state changes across scenes; the frame does
  not merely rescan the same equipment.
- [October 6th episode](https://github.com/Talonsturgill/alaska-ai-weekly/blob/e53f3f92e6cbe123e8802239d8172622d4f3a630/video-engine/src/Ep1006.tsx)
  gives its desk and phone a visual performance, with local anticipation, contact and result.
  Port that causal grammar and reusable finished assets. Do not copy its regional mascot,
  factual claims, source archive, ledger or old footage into Texas.
- The current Alaska master also corrects its old instruction to punctuate every beat with a
  camera kick. Preserve motivated cuts and object reactions. Frequent new information does not
  mean perpetual shake, strobing, overshoot or arbitrary camera motion.

## Two complete treatments, one executable direction

Before voice, design exactly two feasible, complete alternatives. Each needs a first-frame
question, a recognizable throughline subject, an escalation, a fair source-backed turn, a
closing picture that answers the opening, and a sound arc. Different shot ordering, staging
and visual emphasis must give a viewer a different experience. Two camera poses on the same
tableau are one treatment.

Write `film_direction` with the active policy version, registered episode, actual renderer
hashes, angle, opening promise, performed turn, closing answer, shot timeline and rewards.
The shot timeline covers every story frame, conserves subject identity and source-bound scene
timing, and names an implemented view and overlapping physical event. Use at least three useful
framings. A new action, reaction, comparison, consequence or evidence reveal earns each cut.
An empty push, rotating fan or appearing label alone does not count as new understanding.

Before code review, freeze each shot's `scene_fraction_start` and `scene_fraction_end` within its source
scene, and each reward's `event_fraction` within its physical event. These authored anchors
belong to the approved concept. `board_retime.py` derives the measured seconds from them after
voice alignment, without compounding earlier timing. If the measured read breaks the limits
or event overlap, repair the edit; never stretch the narration or silently move a reward.

The current product limits are in `config/modern_film.json`: first visible change within 1.5
seconds, no shot longer than 5 seconds, and no unearned information interval longer than 4
seconds. These are explicit production constraints chosen after the owner rejection, not a
scientific claim about all audiences. Do not bypass them by relabeling a repeated view or
inventing event declarations. Independent review watches the execution at normal speed.

Generate this edition's fresh hero and supporting artwork under STORY_ART.md before animation.
Finish the hero silhouette, contact shadows, layered surfaces, motivated light and focal hierarchy
at native size and 390-pixel phone width before voice. Use authentic licensed footage when it
provides useful action. Otherwise author a source-bound illustration. Do not infer a particular
failure mechanism, measured value, actual operator, hardware design or completed outcome.

## Perform and judge the complete edit

Narration is an energetic, continuous explanation with purposeful contrasts. Begin the action
immediately, keep connective phrases moving, and reserve emphasis and breathing room for the
turn and answer. Do not put a reverent pause after every clause. Shorten slow writing before
synthesis, rather than accelerating the audio. Compare actual take timing with the approved
shot rewards and listen through the existing audiovisual path. Fast unreadable words fail too.

The existing phone critic and three separate final scorers receive this guide's actual text and
hash. At visual/final scope each returns exact-film `modern_observations` for first frame, visual
progression, shot variety, performed turn, pace, closing answer and finished art. Each contains
an observed interval, concrete finding and pass flag. The ordinary rubric and actual failures
remain unchanged. A high average cannot replace a failed engagement or finish observation.

Optional engineering stops at its reserved boundary. If a mandatory current-route observation
fails, preserve that cut and repair through the configured autonomous completion policy, using
the retained independent source-backed pivot when needed. Neither artistic ceilings nor host
capacity authorize a legacy episode, slideshow rescue or unaudited provider substitution.


## The region stands behind every current film

Owner instruction, October 9th, 2026, on the plan's fifth step. Place was the show's weakest axis
(6.36 on the mean of the last ten report cards) and every current film stood in a flat gradient,
so a Harris County story and a Reeves County story looked like the same nowhere.

From the date in `video-engine/src/modern/placePlates.json` (`policy.effective_date`), DirectedFilm
draws each scene's region behind its episode through `modern/PlaceStage.tsx`. Each of the ten
regions has a plate, rendered once in the Docket's carousel engine from a scene page under
`assets/place/scenes/` by `scripts/place_bake.py`, as a sky, one ground and cards for the things
standing on it. The bake measured that the layers reassemble into the picture and that every
camera profile keeps the ground covering the frame and every base on its ground. The manifest
records those measurements, the Docket commit, every layer's sha256 and the hash of each module a
scene imports from `assets/place/`. Water is drawn by `assets/place/water.js` as a mirror of the
world in its own plane, because a lake seen from eye height under a hazy sky otherwise reads as a
pale slab, and no scatter grows on it.

- **The plate is the county's when it has one, and the region's when it doesn't.** A region's own
  plate carries nothing that belongs to one place, no skyline and no refinery, because a Texan is
  not told they live somewhere they don't. Harris County stands in Houston across Buffalo Bayou,
  Dallas County over the Trinity floodplain, Travis County across Lady Bird Lake and Bexar County
  over the river south of downtown. A story at a plant on the upper coast names
  `place_plate: "gulf-shipchannel"` on its scenes for the refineries, which a board may do only for
  a county that plate lists. The fly gene film's labs are in the Medical Center, and a blind grade
  of its frames on October 9th marked the refinery view as the wrong place within the right county.
- **Outdoors** the plate fills the frame and the camera moves through it on the scene's
  `camera_strategy`, within a share of the plate's measured limits. The ground moves by the exact
  perspective transform, so it never tears. Wrap a subject that stands on the ground in
  `<PlaceSubject baseY={...}>` with the frame row its base touches, and it rides with its ground.
  Keep type and overlays outside it.
- **Indoors, wide and medium**, the region is outside a window in the back wall. It starts below
  the title band, it is held still and it is bright and soft, the way a camera exposed for the room
  sees a window, behind a light frame. The episode draws its own floor and props in front of it.
- **Indoors, close and detail**, there is no window, only its light: the region is a soft wash
  behind the subject, because a lens that close is focused on the subject and a window pane behind
  a fly makes the fly as tall as the pane. Any view the episode lists in `wash_views` takes the same
  wash at every framing. List a labelled comparison there, things set out on their own ground lines
  with a label over each, since a window's rails and skyline cross exactly that type and those lines.
- **Overhead**, and any view the episode lists in `wall_views` (a diagram or a document, which is
  not in a room), keep plain wall. No more than 40 percent of a film's shots may be wall views.

**An episode never paints a full-frame background.** That one rect hides the whole region, and
the film looks exactly as it did when place was the weakest axis. Paint the floor, the props and
anything the story needs in the room. `scripts/place_check.py --render` renders every shot with the
plate as solid magenta and fails a shot that shows less than its minimum share of region, by
name. Unboxed type over the window stays dark or gets its own panel, as type over any picture does.

The stage also draws a county locator from two seconds in. A small card draws the state's outline,
fills the first scene's county and rings it, on the vetted map-explainer timing (border 2.5
seconds, fill 1.0, label 0.7). It carries no words, because no claim stands behind a board's
county and the narration names the place. Its map is computed by `scripts/county_map.py`.

A run never bakes a plate. A plate is added or changed by editing its scene page and running
`place_bake.py --docket <a TexasAIDocket checkout>`, and the layers and manifest are committed
together. CI fails a scene or a place module edited without a re-bake. Each plate names the engine
record it was drawn with, the Docket commit and the bytes of every engine file, so a plate rebaked
alone with a newer Docket leaves every other plate's record as it was. The bake measures the layers
as the stage loads them, encoded as lossless WebP and read back, and holds each limit to its
measurements: the last step that passed, the next step's failure and every profile end the stage
moves to. CI measures cover and magnification again from the committed layers at every profile end
and requires the bake's numbers exactly. Open each baked plate's `out/place-bake/<plate>/full.png`
at film size before committing it: the bake measures whether the layers move as one world, never
whether the water reads as water.

## Narration and picture use one clock

For new production from October 8th, every spoken clause has a narration-picture-v1 binding in board.narration_picture. Write exact clause text, concrete subject_ids, executable action_id, source claim_ids, scene_id, cue_ids and event_ids before voice production. Cover all words and qualifiers once in their original order. The registered episode declares which views actually implement those subjects and actions. A topic match, caption or label cannot replace a pictured causal step.

Before voice exists, use timing_mode authored with an explicit provisional cue plan for the silent two-treatment comparison. These estimated windows approve only planning. After alignment, board_retime.py replaces them with measured_caption_boundaries from the actual captions and acoustic word stream. Timed capture, preship and delivery require those measured inputs and reject an authored clock.

After acoustic alignment, compile every clause window from complete measured caption boundaries and the matched positional word stream. Use modern_film.compile_narration with the actual captions and words. Derive cut handoffs from silence between clauses. Only framing subdivisions inside the same subject/action may use fractions. Renderer performances consume requireNarration on the film-global clock, and retain completed consequences across cuts. Never stretch speech, scale cue times, or proportionally place a different narrated action inside a scene.

Run scripts/modern_film.py with --board, --captions, --words, --script and --claims before timed capture and preship. The gate rejects missing or duplicated clauses, omitted qualifiers, stale timing, wrong condition identity, incompatible renderer views and gaps in matching picture coverage. These checks establish bindings, not audience understanding. Code, phone and final reviewers inspect the actual subject and performed action for every clause. Return narration_picture_observations bound to the exact film, with ordered clauses containing id, pass, exact start_s/end_s and observed. Preserve a wrong or absent picture as a source/comprehension blocker even if provider metadata says pass.

A current clause must remain understandable with its captions covered. Introduce the spoken subject before its clause begins, perform the narrated change while it is heard, and retain the relevant result through the clause end. Distinguish selection, analysis, test condition, observed result and clinical limit. Generic clinical forms, a repeated test picture under an AI-selection line, or the normal condition under a patient-variant line fail this contract.
